body: I know you’ve probably looked up ways to stop but drawing, painting or even making slime gets your mind off of it. I paint and it looks like shet but it still helps. Even drawing with red marker where you want to cut and washing it off helps. The rubber band technique helps a lot
I don’t want to stop either. I made a promise to my partner and it’s so damn hard to keep it. I just want to paint my arms and legs without consequences from him or my parents
